name: Cowboy Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as cowboy.vc, the seed fund founded by Aileen Lee (TechCrunch 2023 fund coverage; site lists Drata, Guild, Homebase, Vic.ai). Not Cowboy Space or Cowboy (e-bike company).

pages.title: Cowboy Ventures goes bigger, with $260M across two new funds, including an opportunity fund

website.snippet: We seed trailblazers, changemakers, and legends in the making

thesis_text.value: Seed investor that favours pre-product startups and positions itself as a founder-first partner backed by a community of operators.

open_items: No round recorded: fetched pages name Cowboy as an early investor in Guild Education and Drata (TechCrunch 2023) but do not name Cowboy as a participant in a specific round; portfolio page has no round data. 2026 rounds seen only in search-result summaries (Standard Kernel seed, Derapi, Graici) and not fetched.

Fund date is the TechCrunch publication date (2023-01-23). Also closed $120M first opportunity ('Mustang') fund same day, not recorded (latest-fund-only is the flagship). Earlier funds ($36M 2012, $57M 2014) not confirmed on fetched pages; TechCrunch gives prior funds as $40M, $60M, $95M.
Homepage sector list, check size, and cold-inbound route not recorded (not quotable from fetch summary); site mentions a hello@ general contact and a /how-we-work page, not fetched.
